iti27:2.1: yāni kānici bhikkhave opadhikāni puññakiriyāvatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ
iti27:2.2: mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca.
iti27:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yākāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā sabbā tā candappabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ candappabhā yeva tāni adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca
iti27:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyāvatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ mettā yeva tāni ceto vimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca.
iti27:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsaṃ tamagataṃ abhihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca
iti27:4.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyāvatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca.
iti27:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ osadhitārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate ca
iti27:5.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici opadhikāni puññakiriyāvatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ mettā yeva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate cāti.
